Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the call today. A few follow-ups from our side so we can move this conversation to procurement:

- Can you confirm whether production data for AcmeBank can be pinned to the EU region (Frankfurt) for both inference and logs?
- In the event of a regional outage, what is your cross-region failover behavior? Is replication synchronous or async?
- How are backups handled (RPO/RTO expectations, retention windows, encryption at rest)?
- Any PII handling differences between Hosted and Dedicated modes we should be aware of?

We'd like a short (1-page) diagram and a list of the controls so our security team can review. Also please include any cost delta for EU-only residency + cross-region failover.

John —

Great speaking with you and Samantha today. Quick recap + proposed next steps below. I attached a one-page diagram (redwood-region-pinning-diagram.pdf) and our failover playbook stub.

Recap / answers (short):
- Region pinning: Yes — we can pin inference and logging to the EU (Frankfurt) for Hosted and Dedicated. Dedicated supports stronger isolation (VPC) and customer-managed KMS.
- Failover: Primary replication is asynchronous across regions for warm-standby. We offer an optional active-active topology for enterprise customers with additional configuration and cost.
- Backups: Daily snapshots with 30-day default retention; configurable up to 7 years for compliance. Backups are encrypted at rest using customer KMS (Dedicated) or Redwood-managed KMS (Hosted). RTO target for warm-standby failover is 15–60 minutes depending on the workload and whether KV cache warmup is required.
- PII handling: PII can be restricted to the pinned region; we do not use customer text for model training. For Dedicated/Private deployments, you can disable telemetry/usage logging.

Next steps:
1) Vanessa — please confirm technical failover behavior and backup retention options we typically recommend for banks, and flag any config that requires additional engineering time.
2) Marissa — I'll loop you for a brief pricing estimate for EU-only residency + warm failover delta.
3) John/Samantha — can you confirm the list of systems we should include in the diagram (App gateway, inference endpoints, audit logs, backups)?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi John —

Following up with the technical details for your security team. Short answers and then a recommended config for a regulated bank: 

Short answers:
- Region pinning: We pin inference requests, generated outputs, and audit logs to the customer-selected region. For Hosted, logs are stored in the selected cloud region; for Dedicated we also support customer VPC peering and retention controls.
- Replication / failover: Cross-region replication is asynchronous by default (near-real-time). This means RPO is near-zero for persistent storage, but KV cache may need warm-up after failover. We provide an automated failover playbook; expected RTO for warm-standby is 15–60 minutes.
- Active-active: Supported as an enterprise option — requires configuration to avoid split-brain and comes with additional cost (networking + higher throughput).
- Backups & retention: Daily encrypted snapshots. Default retention: 30 days. Optional immutable backups for compliance, configurable retention up to 7 years. Backups stored in the selected region unless you opt-in to cross-region replication for geo-redundancy.
- Logging & PII: Audit logs are kept in-region by default. Telemetry can be disabled, and PII can be masked at ingest. We never use customer-provided text for model training (per our data use policy).
- Encryption/KMS: Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS by default; Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own). We support HSM integrations for Private deployments.

Recommended (baseline) config for Acme Bank (EU residency + failover):
- Pin inference + audit logs to eu-central-1 (Frankfurt).
- Daily snapshots retained 90 days initially; enable immutable monthly snapshot for audit retention.
- Warm-standby in us-west-2 for failover (async replication). Failover playbook run quarterly; one scheduled test during onboarding.
- Use customer-managed KMS for Dedicated or Private. Disable telemetry.

Attachments: redwood-region-pinning-diagram.pdf, redwood-failover-playbook.pdf

Cost delta (very rough): EU-only residency + warm standby adds ~15–25% to baseline Hosted pricing due to cross-region storage & egress; Dedicated pricing varies — I'll work with Marissa for a firm estimate.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
